integrity: The exact embedded data and executable certificate validate the face sets, Morse matchings, cover-incidence acyclicity, and signed rational and binary simplicial boundary ranks. The proof of the mixed-dimensional attaching map uses exact rational rank, not finite-field evidence alone.
scientific_limitations: The enumeration of all isomorphism classes relies on the external published fifteen-representative catalogue. Calculations and exact acyclic matchings are independently reconstructible for each representative, but no general result for larger tournaments is claimed. Independent expert validation has not been performed.
title: Eight homotopy types among the fifteen regular nine-vertex tournament neighborhood complexes
